FAIL_TO_PASS: reassign-pattern-defaults: makes sure reassignments of pattern defaults are tracked
track-assignment-side-effect-via-destructuring: tracks property assignment side effects for destructured variables
no-treeshake-react: passes when bundling React without tree-shaking
deconflict-destructured-for-default-side-effects: makes sure to deconflict variables that are destructured for side effects in their default values only
include-unused-destructured-getters: destructures unused properties with getter side effects
destructuring-loop: handles loops with destructuring declarations
get-literal-value-via-destructuring: retrieves literal values from destructured variables
side-effects-pattern-assignment: side-effects when mutating destructured variables should not be ignored
tdz-pattern-access: handles accessing variables declared in patterns before their declaration
remove-props-via-destructuring: removes unused nested properties through destructuring declarations
propertyReadSideEffects-always: verify property accesses are retained for getters with side effects
no-treeshake: all code should be included if tree-shaking is disabled
side-effects-computed-pattern-keys: side-effects in with computed pattern keys should not be ignored
export-destruction: handle destruction patterns in export declarations
cycles-dependency-with-TLA-await-import: throw a warn when a cycle is detected which includes a top-level await import
get-return-expression-via-destructuring: retrieves return expressions from destructured variables
deoptimize-object-via-destructured-getter: deoptimizes the object if a mutating getter is destructured
tree-shake-deterministic-dynamic-import: treeshakes dynamic imports when the target is deterministic
for-loop-parameter: includes for-loop parameters
system-export-destructuring-declaration: supports destructuring declarations for systemJS
